title: cann-attribution-overlap
summary: Attribute NPU trace kernels to model source and plan bounded multistream overlap: select a representative step, map kernels to source owners via code_ref, build the module/operator dependency DAG (data, state, event, collective-order edges), classify serial/candidate/pending groups, choose minimal-first overlap with an explicit execution-mode synchronization contract, and accept only through correctness-first checks. Keeps the !302 import lineage distinct from later revisions, carries known formula/threshold conflicts as unresolved, and qualifies memory evidence by domain (device HBM/UB counters are not host RAM). Planning procedure only — no formula automation for disputed definitions.

applicability.scope: Attribute representative CANN trace kernels to source owners and plan bounded multistream overlap using data, state, event and collective-order dependencies.
applicability.prerequisites: Pin the installed CANN/TorchNPU/TorchAir versions before choosing one execution-mode synchronization API family; communication proposals require communication evidence.
applicability.input_contract: Representative-step selection and shapes, kernel/stream inventory with code_ref, adjacent wait windows and dependency edges; communication analysis also needs rank/transport evidence.
applicability.produced_artifact: An attribution map, serial/candidate/pending dependency groups and a minimal overlap plan with joins, enable/fallback path, resource tradeoffs and acceptance checks.
applicability.failure_modes: Kernel names and mechanical coverage can misidentify ownership; logical independence can hide resource contention, and overlap ratios or summed durations can hide unchanged wall time or new tails.

recommendations: Join hotspots to source owners and adjacent wait windows before selecting a target; keep compute cost, waiting and host gaps separate.
Build explicit data/state/event/collective-order edges, then verify one correct overlap point before increasing overlap or partitioning resources.
Require observed overlap, preserved state/order and fallback behavior plus latency and outside-module checks; report wall time, interval unions and duration sums separately.
Carry disputed formulas and source-revision distinctions forward; device free time alone does not identify Python, GIL or OS causes without matching host evidence.
